en: Only the post owner can edit this post.
zh-Hans: 只有作者可以编辑这篇动态。

en: Comments are unavailable for this post.
The account or content changed. Open a new review.
zh-Hans: 账号或内容已变化，请重新预览。

en: Unable to load this information. Try again.
zh-Hans: 暂时无法获取信息，请重试。

en: Offline example. All people, records and outcomes here are synthetic.
zh-Hans: 离线示例。人物、记录和结果均为虚构测试数据。

en: This link is incomplete. Go back to choose another item.
zh-Hans: 链接不完整，请返回选择其他内容。

en: Sign in to see your relationship
Follow and conversation actions can be reviewed. Live actions remain unavailable.
zh-Hans: 可预览关注和发起会话操作，线上操作暂未开放。

en: Sign in to load this member’s posts.
zh-Hans: 登录后查看该用户的动态。

en: Follow checkpoints in order with your group. Good for planned meetups and story-based routes.
zh-Hans: 和队友按顺序打卡通关，适合约人同行和有剧情的路线。

en: Explore open checkpoints in your own order and at your own pace.
zh-Hans: 点位全部开放，按自己的顺序和节奏探索。

en: Walk and discover the city with no required finish line.
zh-Hans: 边走边探索城市，不必追赶终点。
玩法说明上线后会显示在这里。

en: This guide is no longer available. Go back to the guide list.
zh-Hans: 这篇说明已不可用，请返回玩法列表。

en: This guide does not have readable content yet.
zh-Hans: 这篇说明暂时没有正文。

en: Invitation records are available, but rewards are not fully synchronized. Missing rewards do not establish that a first purchase is pending.
zh-Hans: 邀请记录已获取，奖励流水尚未完整同步。未查到奖励不代表首购尚未完成。

en: Your invited members will appear here after they join.
zh-Hans: 受邀用户加入后会显示在这里。

en: The next page repeated existing records. Refresh to try again.
zh-Hans: 下一页重复了已有记录，请刷新后重试。
已加入 · 首购待完成
已加入 · 奖励待同步

en: Review only. Live posting, replies, reactions, reports, follows and conversation creation are disabled.
zh-Hans: 仅供预览。线上发帖、回复、互动、举报、关注和创建会话均未开放。

en: Editing text keeps the existing images and linked activity or route.
zh-Hans: 编辑文字会保留已有图片和关联活动或路线。

en: This is the requested state, not a claim about the current saved state.
zh-Hans: 此处是希望设置的状态，不代表服务端当前状态。

en: The source action toggles the existing comment like. An uncertain result must not be retried automatically.
zh-Hans: 此操作会切换评论点赞状态。结果未确认时不能自动重试。

en: Send this item to the review queue. The source endpoint accepts the item ID only, with no reason or evidence fields.
zh-Hans: 将此内容提交审核队列。源接口只接受内容编号，不接受理由或证据字段。

en: Toggle the current follow relationship once. The server must confirm the resulting relationship; an uncertain result stays locked.
zh-Hans: 切换一次当前关注关系。结果必须由服务端确认，未确认时保留锁定。

en: Request a conversation with this member. Navigation requires a positive conversation ID from the server.
zh-Hans: 请求与该用户建立会话，只有服务端返回有效会话编号后才能打开聊天。

en: An acknowledgement does not prove that content is published or visible. The server remains authoritative.
zh-Hans: 请求已确认不等于内容已发布或可见，最终结果以服务端为准。

en: Nothing was sent. Start a new review when ready.
zh-Hans: 未发送任何内容，可重新预览。

en: The request was rejected. Review the content before trying again.
zh-Hans: 请求被拒绝，请检查内容后再操作。

en: The outcome is unknown. This action is locked to avoid duplicates. Returning or signing in again will not retry it.
zh-Hans: 操作结果未确认，已锁定以防重复。返回页面或重新登录不会重试。

en: Synthetic acknowledgement only. Nothing was sent externally.
zh-Hans: 仅为模拟确认，未向外部发送任何内容。

en: The server acknowledged the request. Refresh the original page for the current state.
zh-Hans: 服务端已确认请求，请刷新原页面查看最新状态。

en: Live image loading awaits approved media origins and size-limited downloads.
zh-Hans: 线上图片加载需先确认媒体来源并验证下载大小限制。

en: Loading connects to the media host below without account credentials. No upload is performed.
zh-Hans: 加载时会连接下方媒体站点，不发送账号凭据，也不会上传内容。

en: The image could not be loaded or decoded safely.
zh-Hans: 图片无法加载或安全解码。

en: This message does not contain a supported secure image address.
zh-Hans: 这条消息不包含支持的安全图片地址。
